Method of Attack: Compromise of Passwordstate app's In-Place Upgrade functionality to deliver malware in a supply-chain attack
Malware harvested system info and Passwordstate data
Malware added a loader code section to pull next stage payload from C2 server
Malware extracted and posted system and Passwordstate data to attacker-controlled CDN network
Malware sleeps for 1 day and repeats harvesting and uploading process
Impacted Systems: Passwordstate instances used by over 370,000 security and IT professionals at 29,000 companies
Attack Vector: Compromised In-Place Upgrade functionality pointing to a malicious CDN network not controlled by Click Studios
Indicators of Compromise: Malformed Passwordstate_upgrade.zip downloaded between April 20 8:33 PM UTC and April 22 0:30 AM UTC
Hash of malicious loader DLL shared by CSIS Security Group A/S
Command-and-control server addresses used by malware
Malicious loader code section of approximately 4KB added to Passwordstate code
